name: Latencia. Toma el control...  o la mejor decisión
dialogues: A few years ago, The Universidad Autonoma Metropolitana Unidad Cuajimalpa had a difficult case of dating violence between its students
Even with the supplies they had to prevent the problem, they were looking for a innovative tool to connect with the young audience
Worked, along with a interdisciplinary team, on the development of a videogame to prevent dating violence
I had the role of project leader and set a agile methodology to work
Took part in co-design activities with future users on different stages of development
Made the wireframing and game documentation
Developed the game for desktop, mobile and web
